description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity demonstrating SMS handling, default app detection, and UI interactions for an SMS sample app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for SMS sample app, handling SMS display, sending, and default app management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up list adapter, and loader for SMS messages.

methods.name: sendSms
methods.description: Placeholder method to send SMS if app is default, shows toast otherwise.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks and updates UI based on whether app is default SMS app; shows phone number.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates loader to query SMS inbox.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates adapter with loaded SMS cursor.
